text:
Adin Hill had a season to forget last year: 15 goals below expected in 27 games by our numbers. This one has started the other way. He is 7-2-0 in nine starts with a .903 save percentage, 1.8 goals saved above expected, and a 28-save win in Buffalo on Nov. 8 that The Athletic's Matthew Fairburn called "an incredible game" from Hill.

The highlight reel is real (Jesse Granger, also of The Athletic, has written about him "inventing new saves"), but our numbers add a caution. Hill has been good on medium-danger shots (.903 against a league .864) and only .621 on the high-danger ones, against a league .685. That is the kind of split that can flip either way over a full season.

He has a Stanley Cup ring from 2022-23 and a 2024-25 that Evolving-Hockey rated as one of his best, so the good version is not new. What to watch: whether his high-danger stopping comes up to meet the rest of his game as the season goes on.
headline: Adin Hill is winning again for Vegas
